notes.title: Bullet Runner: The Prologue Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]If you know what The BFG is, then this game is made for you
[/h1]
[i]Bullet Runner is Doom-esque top-down shooter coming in late 2023 but releasing a 4-hour free prologue version out already in November 2022. Load your BFG and get in the game![/i]

Bullet Runner is like pure adrenaline poured into your brain and veins, just like the good ol’ days with Doom and Quake. You are Jack, and for some reason everyone wants you dead. Buller Runner is a top-down shooter where you run your way through the enemy-filled facility shooting, blasting, and raging through any obstacle set in your way.

[i]“My love for DOOM Eternal is very strong, and I wanted to create my own kind of homage to the Doom series. Fighting and especially the glory kill mechanisms will be familiar for all like minded players, but in Bullet Runner the main character is just a regular badass-Jack''[/i] tells Laura Moon, the developer behind the game.

[previewyoutube=GXS0Vzm3XcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is set to be released in late 2023 with well over 10 hours of gameplay, but the developer prepared a special free prologue to be released already in November 2022. The prologue will feature a lot of game to play – it will take about 3—4 hours for an average player to slay through the game. It is clear this prologue is not a demo, but a full game with specifically designed levels.

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Action-packed top-down shooter with free 4-hour prologue out in November 2022
[*] Lots of guns and items, glory-kills, missions to solve, enemies to slay, and smooth movement extras like rail slides, running on barrels, and chain swings
[*] Prologue out until the 31st of December, with updated and new features hinted during the period
[/list]
 
Bullet Runner on Steam (Prologue opening on Tue, November 22nd 2022 as a Steam Playtest): [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/[/url]

Trailer on YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GXS0Vzm3XcQ]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GXS0Vzm3XcQ[/url]
Bullet Runner on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/Bullet_Runner]https://twitter.com/Bullet_Runner[/url]

notes.title: Bullet Runner - Demo V1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We hope you're all doing good. We've just released an update for the Bullet Runner demo build. This update includes a range of visual and performance improvements, as well as new game-feel additions and polishing.

[previewyoutube=_KIjOZ-uQwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try, and let us know what you think!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3Sc8dQqHr5]Join our Discord![/url]

[b]Changes/Additions[/b]

- Added level intro sequences
- Modified level starting areas
- Greatly reduced chance of player catchphrases
- Tweaks, changes and improvements to game menu's
- Moved weapon-reel to the top-right of the screen
- Added option to set weapon-reel to either center or top-right of the screen
- Recoded the entire chain system (it's a LOT more reliable and snappier now)
- Zoomed out the gameplay camera for better visibility in arena fights
- Slightly improved the game's performance
- Added lighting colorization effects to 3D sprites

notes.title: Devlog #4 - New songs included in the game!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to devlog 4![/b] 

We are very happy that you are here :) December was a very busy month for us, so we hope that the results of our hard work will please you! After all, your opinion is very important to us.

We're excited to announce that the [b]tier selection screen[/b] - which we showed you in the previous development journal is almost complete! 

Here you can see what it looks like at the moment:

[previewyoutube=oaA9W13nciM;full][/previewyoutube]


We also teamed up with the rapper to create an amazing [b]original track[/b] for "Bullet Runner" that will be used in the opening credits reel. 

We think it will give our game an amazing atmosphere:

[previewyoutube=2aYq3-80q9c;full][/previewyoutube]


Besides, we also worked on:

- New movement mechanics

- The save system has been updated to support level replays

- The level selection screen environment has been updated

- Screen shake and camera tilt now have a lower default value


We hope you will like all the changes and novelties. Let me know what you think about the new rap song ;)




Of course, we also invite you to our discord channel, where all the news appear, and you have the opportunity to talk to us about the project! 

Join the community on Discord:  https://discord.gg/3Sc8dQqHr5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628292/5db1e7f1a70edeabe7b65aab4c0a43ec23930458.png[/img]


Thank you for being with us. See you soon!
